paragraphs.text: The Heart of Kiran is a legendary vehicle on Avishkar .

The Heart of Kiran was an airship that flew in the skies of Kaladesh. It was named after Kiran Nalaar . When the Renegades attacked the Consulate's Spire , Baan boarded the ship and sabotaged the Hope of Ghirapur , which was an essential part of their strategy. He then planeswalked away when Chandra arrived and attacked with her flames.
